summary: Rubico Inc. filed a 6-K announcing its decision to divest a newbuilding megayacht (60m, 1,150 GT, delivery Q2 2027) to exit the megayacht sector and redeploy capital to its core tanker business. The company estimates gross cash proceeds of €30-35M (~$34.2-40M) and would eliminate a €26.5M (~$30.2M) capital commitment. No specific buyer, definitive agreement, or advisor is named. The transaction is subject to negotiation and counterparty consent. No deal mechanics or timeline are specified. Watch for definitive agreements and regulatory approvals; no risk-arb opportunity yet as terms are preliminary.
